BrochureContent.Content:
Dixon Residential Estate Agents are delighted to present 15 Parkview Drive to the Finglas property market.

This superb duplex apartment offers bright, spacious, and well-appointed accommodation throughout, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors alike.

Upon entering the property, you are welcomed by an entrance hallway with stairs leading to the first floor. This level comprises a generous double bedroom and a modern family bathroom.

The upper floor features a stunning open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area, flooded with natural light from large windows that create a bright and inviting atmosphere. Also located on this level is the spacious master bedroom with en-suite bathroom, together with a convenient utility room.

The property further benefits from designated parking and additional visitor parking.

Ideally situated in the highly sought-after Parkview development, residents enjoy direct access to Poppintree Park and are within easy reach of Finglas Village, Glasnevin, and Charlestown Shopping Centre. A wide range of local amenities are nearby, including the Botanical Gardens, IKEA, and DCU.

Excellent transport links are available, with the M50 and N2 motorways close at hand, while Dublin Bus routes 9, 83, 140, and 220 provide convenient access to Dublin City Centre and surrounding areas.

Early viewing is highly recommended. Contact Dixon Residential Estate Agents today to arrange a viewing.
